purpose: Package existing DIO organs and proved product-class capabilities into buyer-legible Design Studio and Legal Operations offers without inventing new engines or changing the canonical atlas product-class count.
truth_boundary: These are commercial incarnations/compositions over existing DIO organs. Registration here does not create a new executor, customer validation, legal authority, public release authority, guaranteed outcome, certification, filing authority, or payment authority. Each incarnation must earn controlled composition execution proof before it may be described as execution-proved.

design_studio.label: DIO Design Studio
design_studio.commercial_job: Create polished, governed public-facing assets from a bounded customer brief while preserving meaning, provenance and human release authority.

legal_operations.label: DIO Legal Operations
legal_operations.commercial_job: Turn legal/compliance prerequisites, obligations, evidence and draft materials into review-ready operational packs without pretending DIO is a lawyer or regulator.

incarnations.name: DIO Site Studio
incarnations.pricing_basis: one bounded small-business or professional-service website pilot
incarnations.buyer_problem: The customer needs a credible website, coherent copy, visual direction and lead capture but does not want to coordinate separate copy, design, development and intake tools.
incarnations.promise: A research-informed, responsive website package with governed copy, visual direction, structured lead intake and review-ready deployment assets.
outputs: visual asset brief or generated approved assets

composition.role: market research, positioning, visual and creative production
semantic copy custody, language/register control and approved localisation
structured content and deterministic render/format discipline
governed public intake and customer interaction

incarnations.authority_boundary: DIO may prepare and package the site. Domain ownership, public deployment, factual claims, legal notices, external publication and paid services remain explicitly authorised actions.

incarnations.name: DIO Launch Studio
incarnations.pricing_basis: one bounded launch campaign with one primary offer and approved channel set
incarnations.buyer_problem: A new offer needs a coherent website, brand direction, launch creative and lead route rather than disconnected assets from different vendors.
incarnations.promise: One governed launch spine covering positioning, site, creative family, short-form media, channel copy and structured lead intake.
outputs: reel/short-form scripts and held media assets

composition.role: campaign research, creative and media production
semantic campaign custody and learned held-draft patterns
campaign evidence and channel outcome observation

incarnations.authority_boundary: DIO may research, draft, render, package and learn from observed outcomes. Publication, external messaging, media spend, commitments and pricing changes remain separately authorised.

incarnations.name: DIO Report & Pitch Studio
incarnations.pricing_basis: one bounded report, proposal or presentation transformation pilot
incarnations.buyer_problem: The customer has useful content or evidence but the final report, proposal or deck is visually weak, inconsistent or difficult to review.
incarnations.promise: Turn governed source content into polished, audience-ready reports, proposals and pitch decks without silently rewriting the underlying meaning.

composition.role: formatting, conversion and deterministic document rendering
visual narrative, audience and presentation direction

incarnations.authority_boundary: DIO may restructure presentation and render approved source meaning. It does not invent evidence, create endorsements, approve investor representations or replace professional sign-off.

incarnations.name: DIO POPIA Readiness
incarnations.pricing_basis: one bounded organisational readiness review, not legal advice or certification
incarnations.buyer_problem: The organisation has personal-information handling, website forms, vendors and policy obligations but lacks one evidence-bound view of what exists, what is missing and what needs authorised review.
incarnations.promise: A review-ready POPIA operational evidence pack containing data/process inventory inputs, prerequisite checks, policy/document drafts, evidence gaps and a human decision queue.

composition.role: legal/platform prerequisite and evidence readiness gates

incarnations.authority_boundary: DIO POPIA Readiness is an operational readiness and document-preparation service. It does not provide legal advice, certify POPIA compliance, make regulator determinations or act as an attorney, information officer, regulator or authorised signatory.

incarnations.name: DIO Corporate Readiness
incarnations.pricing_basis: one bounded South African company-record and filing-readiness pilot, excluding government fees and professional advice
incarnations.buyer_problem: Company records, beneficial-ownership evidence, annual-return prerequisites and change deadlines are easy to discover too late or keep in disconnected folders.
incarnations.promise: A governed corporate-readiness file that maps company evidence, filing prerequisites, ownership/change evidence, missing items, deadlines and authorised handoff steps.

composition.role: current prerequisite, identity and evidence readiness gates
bounded reminders, intake and human escalation

incarnations.authority_boundary: DIO Corporate Readiness prepares records, checklists, evidence and deadline support. It does not determine beneficial ownership as a legal conclusion, submit filings autonomously, act as a company secretary/legal practitioner, or guarantee CIPC acceptance or continued registration.

incarnations.name: DIO Contract Desk
incarnations.pricing_basis: one bounded agreement plus obligation/register setup pilot
incarnations.buyer_problem: Important dates, deliverables, evidence requirements and responsibilities are buried inside agreements and then tracked manually in email, calendars and spreadsheets.
incarnations.promise: A review-ready contract operations pack with extracted obligations, dates, evidence requirements, unresolved interpretation questions and an ongoing obligation register.

composition.role: legal/platform prerequisite evidence gates where applicable
bounded intake, reminders and human escalation

incarnations.authority_boundary: DIO Contract Desk extracts, tracks and packages contractual information for review. It does not provide legal interpretation, decide enforceability, negotiate, accept risk, vary a contract, bind a party, or send consequential notices without authorised human action.

portfolio_summary.next_gate: Run local composition smoke/proof for each incarnation, then expose bounded storefront/intake routes without changing the canonical 53-class truth.
